What We Do

Complete Solar Care Services

From preventive maintenance to emergency repairs — we handle everything your solar plant needs.

Preventive Maintenance

Regular inspections and scheduled maintenance to prevent failures, reduce downtime, and keep your solar plant running reliably.

Solar Modules Cleaning

Professional module cleaning to remove dust, dirt, and bird droppings and maintain maximum solar generation.

Emergency Breakdown Support

Fast on-site support for critical faults and breakdowns to minimize downtime and restore plant operations quickly.

SCADA Monitoring

Continuous SCADA monitoring to track plant performance, identify alarms, and detect issues at an early stage.

Inverter Maintenance

Inspection, cleaning, testing, and troubleshooting of inverters to ensure reliable operation and optimal performance.

Transformer Maintenance

Routine inspection and maintenance of transformers to ensure safe operation, reliability, and long service life.

VCB Maintenance

Inspection, testing, and preventive maintenance of VCBs to ensure safe and reliable switching and protection.

HT Panel Maintenance

Comprehensive HT panel inspection and maintenance to ensure electrical safety, protection, and reliable power distribution.

Electrical Testing

Professional AC/DC electrical testing to identify faults, insulation issues, loose connections, and other potential risks.

Earthing Testing

Earthing system testing to verify proper grounding, electrical safety, and effective fault-current protection.

Vegetation Control

Regular vegetation management around the solar plant to prevent shading, improve accessibility, and maintain site safety.

11kV D.P. Structure

Inspection and maintenance of 11kV D.P. structures to ensure safe, stable, and reliable power transmission.

Performance Analysis

Detailed generation and performance analysis to identify losses, underperformance, and opportunities to improve plant output.

Warranty Support

Technical support for identifying warranty-related issues and coordinating with OEMs for inspection, claims, and resolution.

Our Process

How SolarCare Works

A systematic 9-step approach to keep your solar plant at peak performance.

01

Site Inspection

Comprehensive visual inspection of the entire plant to assess current condition and identify issues.

02

Health Assessment

Detailed analysis of plant performance data, equipment health, and generation trends.

03

Preventive Maintenance

Scheduled maintenance of all equipment including inverters, transformers, and panels.

04

Monitoring

24×7 SCADA monitoring with real-time alerts for any deviation from expected performance.

05

Fault Detection

Proactive identification of potential faults using thermography and electrical testing.

06

Repair

Swift corrective actions to address identified faults and restore optimal performance.

07

Testing

Post-repair testing and verification to ensure all systems operate at peak efficiency.

08

Performance Report

Detailed monthly reports with generation data, PR ratio analysis, and improvement recommendations.

09

Continuous Support

Ongoing support with dedicated account manager and rapid emergency response.

About SolarCare

Professional Solar Maintenance & Service

SolarCare is a professional solar maintenance and service platform that helps residential and commercial solar owners keep their systems clean, safe, and performing efficiently. From panel cleaning and preventive maintenance to troubleshooting and AMC plans, we make solar care simple, reliable, and transparent.

  • Complete Solar Care — Cleaning, inspection, maintenance, troubleshooting, and AMC services in one place.
  • Professional Technicians — Trained service professionals following standard checklists and safety practices.
  • Transparent Service — Before-and-after photos, service reports, clear pricing, and service history.
  • Faster Support — Easy booking, technician assignment, service tracking, and priority emergency response.
